description: Create images and short videos from text in your Abracadabrax workspace. Prepare a project in the conversation, choose a supported model, aspect ratio and video length, then review the settings before requesting generation. Check an existing job and retrieve its completed output in chat or open the saved project on Abracadabrax. Generation requires a connected Abracadabrax account with available credits and sends the supplied prompt to the selected model provider. Uploaded or reference media, editing, upscaling and social publishing are not supported by this app. Results are AI-generated.
